definitions.length: Measured centreline polyline length in 3D; missing remains blank
definitions.equivalent_area: Closed-solid volume divided by centreline length; not nominal polygon area
definitions.volume: Closed solid per entity, gross per labour. No global excavation total without Boolean union
definitions.tonnage: Root stope mineral volume multiplied by editable assumed density
definitions.fill: Sum of uniquely identified FILL_CUT solids; stages are consecutive, not simultaneous openings
definitions.separate_mineral_excavation: ORE_STOPE_TOTAL counted once; ORE_CUT/STOPE_TOTAL/REFERENCE never counted again
